title: To-do list
summary: A working browser task list. Add, complete and delete tasks; changes are saved in this browser without an account.
features: Browser-local saving with storage error feedback
Touch and keyboard controls; no account
adaptations: Retain original MIT license and source attribution
Remove remote font imports; no external resources needed
Add dependency-free local serving with private-file denial
Keyboard and touch task completion/deletion controls replace mouse-only gestures
Namespace browser storage and preserve malformed saved data instead of overwriting it
Render task text as text and retain save-failure feedback
Use in-page actions inside Lyre's unchanged sandbox; no form-submission or native-modal permission required
